data.name: Perk Up
data.detailed_description:
Perk Up!

A Multiplayer Deck-Building Fighting Game Where Death Makes You Stronger!

About the Game:
Perk Up! is a fast-paced multiplayer fighting game with a unique twist—dying isn’t the end, it’s just the beginning! In this brutal arena, every elimination makes you stronger, pushing you closer to becoming the ultimate warrior.

Key Features:

  • Deck-Building Combat: Choose from an insane 31,569,011,603,496,215,106,480 build possibilities! Start with nothing but your weapon, and with each elimination, pick new perks, power-ups, and abilities to evolve into the ultimate fighter.

  • Die to Grow Stronger: Every time you're eliminated, you gain new abilities and power-ups—turning death into your greatest advantage.

  • Last One Standing: Battle against other players, outsmart your enemies, and survive until you're the strongest warrior left.

Join the Fight!
Are you ready to embrace the chaos, build the ultimate loadout, and prove you’re the best? Join the fight now!
